description: This file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableFeatureDefinition' implementing the 'FeatureDefinition' interface. It provides methods to parse feature definitions from JSON arrays, manage internal identifiers, and serialize back to JSON. It also includes a nested builder class for constructing instances fluently.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatureDefinition
classes.description: An immutable implementation of FeatureDefinition that encapsulates a list of identifiers, provides JSON serialization, and supports stream and iterator access.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatureDefinition.Builder
classes.description: A nested builder class for fluently constructing ImmutableFeatureDefinition instances with add/remove capabilities.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JsonArray to create an ImmutableFeatureDefinition, filtering for string values and converting them into definitions.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder instance initialized with a first identifier.

methods.name: getFirstIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the first definition identifier in the list.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a Stream of all identifiers.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the identifiers.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the list of identifiers into a JsonArray.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on the identifier list.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on identifier list.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the object.
